institutionally_supported_added.title: La Visitation (Geneva modello)

This distinguishes Geneva modello from the monumental Villeneuve-lès-Avignon canvas; selected Commons and historic collection listings supply candidate Geneva accession 1942-0009 but no direct MAH object notice fetched.
